info.title: Animica Free AI API
info.description: Free, keyless, OpenAI-compatible inference plus GPU-miner media dispatch on animica.dev. No API key required (any placeholder Authorization header is also accepted). Inference is served by community GPU workers on the Animica network: check the per-model boolean `serving` flag in GET /v1/models before sending work — requests to a non-serving model may queue for a long time or fail. When a worker is serving, completions typically take 1-3 minutes; use stream:true and a client timeout of at least 300s. Rate limit: 30 requests/minute per IP (burst 12) on /v1/*; media generation paths are limited to 12/minute (burst 6).
info.x-guidance: Free keyless OpenAI-compatible inference: POST /v1/chat/completions (30 req/min/IP; check each model's 'serving' flag via GET /v1/models first). Paid x402 demo endpoint: GET /x402/paid/echo returns HTTP 402 with payment requirements (USDC on Base, exact scheme); pay via any x402 client. Chain data is free at https://rpc.animica.org/rpc and https://explorer.animica.org/api.

servers.description: Free public endpoint (no auth); all paths below are absolute

get.summary: List available models (with live serving flags)
get.description: Returns the live model list: kimi-k3 (default, flagship coding & chat), animica-chat, animica-chat-small, animica-chat-flagship, and animica-knowledge (ENA, network-trained). Each entry carries a boolean `serving` flag: whether a community GPU worker is live for that model right now. serving=false means requests may queue for a long time or fail - check this flag before POSTing to /v1/chat/completions, and prefer a model with serving=true.

429.description: Rate limited (30 req/min per IP, burst 12). The 429 body is an HTML error page, not JSON - back off and retry.

post.description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions, keyless. Served by the Animica miner network - expect 1-3 minute latency when a worker is serving (see the serving flag in /v1/models); set stream:true for SSE with keepalives and use a client timeout >= 300s (the gateway holds the request up to 600s).

post.summary: Upload a binary input for a GPU Studios media job
post.description: Raw binary body (no multipart). Caps: video/blend 512 MB, audio/reference 200 MB. Unconsumed uploads expire after 4 h; inputs are wiped when the owning job delivers or expires.

post.summary: Submit a media job to the GPU-miner queue
post.description: GPU Studios kinds (9.0.0): video_upscale, video_interpolate, video_subtitles, video_bgremove, video_shorts, audio_stems, audio_isolate, audio_enhance, audio_master, render_blender. Plus existing prompt kinds (image, video_t2v, video_multiscene, video_i2v, audio). Upload-consuming jobs reference inputs via upload_ids.

200.description: Job state; small results inline as result.b64, large results at result_url; render_blender parents report chunks_done/chunks_total

get.description: Streams the result (mime + Content-Disposition). Addressed by job id (from result_url). Wiped on TTL (6 h private / 24 h public).

200.description: Counts of online miners per job kind

get.summary: List model tiers with live availability

200.description: Tier list; each entry has code, label, description, chain_tier, requires_pro and a live boolean `available` flag

post.summary: Generate an image, video or audio clip (queued to GPU miners)
post.description: OpenAI-style media facade. media_type is images, videos or audio. Returns 202 with a job id immediately: media on Animica is dispatch-only - jobs are rendered by GPU miners and accepted (202) jobs persist in queue until one is online. A 503 no_media_miner means the dispatcher was unreachable and the submission did NOT enqueue - resubmit. Poll the returned poll_url (GET /api/mkt/v1/media/jobs/{id}) for status and the result. Check live miner availability first at GET /api/mkt/v1/media/capabilities (a kind count of 0 means the job will wait). Rate limit 12 req/min per IP, burst 6.

poll_url.description: GET this path for job status/result

429.description: Rate limited (12 req/min per IP, burst 6)

503.description: Media dispatcher unreachable. JSON body: {"error":{"code":"no_media_miner","type":"unavailable",...},"animica":{"dispatch":"miner","status":"queue_unreachable"}} - resubmit shortly.

get.summary: x402-gated echo — pay $0.005 in USDC on Base per call

402.description: Payment required — body and PAYMENT-REQUIRED header carry x402 payment requirements (exact scheme, Base USDC)

200.description: Echo response after verified x402 payment; settlement receipt in the PAYMENT-RESPONSE header

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: Any text to echo back; all query parameters are echoed in the JSON response

serving.description: true if a community GPU worker is live for this model right now; if false, requests may queue for a long time or fail

model.description: e.g. kimi-k3 (default), animica-chat, animica-chat-small, animica-chat-flagship, animica-knowledge (see GET /v1/models and its per-model serving flag)
